title: Cat replaces zoomies with acrobatics and spends day doing somersaults
description:
While most cats spend their time plotting zoomies and knocking things off shelves, this 8-year-old whiskered wonder has retired from chaos and found a new groove.

Shared by Tate, this furry superstar has turned flipping into a full-time hobby.

From belly twists to tail spins, every move is a masterpiece in motion, like a gymnast with zero deadlines.

While kittens are out there running in circles, this senior kitty is casually redefining cat comedy, one airborne somersault at a time.
